svg.title: Where the savings number comes from
svg.desc: Each Claude CLI turn writes its four token counts into the hash-chained audit log; compute_cost_efficiency prices them with the rate card and against a reference model; the console Models panel shows the result with its time window.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Proof path — from a turn to the number you see

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing is estimated from a sample: every priced turn is a record in the audit chain you can re-sum yourself.
